_comment: SalesKick ICP scoring model — applied deterministically by scripts/score.py. Edit here, not in code.

gates._comment: Hard filters — ALL must pass or lead is discarded (tier=null, score=0).

fit_dimensions._comment: Each dimension contributes up to its max_points. Max raw fit score = 15.

tech_stack._note: Inferred from LinkedIn company page, job postings, or BuiltWith.

icp_engagement_quality._note: How they engaged with the influencer post.

triggers._comment: High-intent bonus signals. Max bonus = sum of all item bonuses (do not exceed max_total_bonus).

items.description: The influencer post they engaged with is explicitly about sales coaching, training, or methodology.
Lead or the post they engaged with mentions quota attainment struggles, missed targets, or revenue gaps.
Lead or post mentions AE ramp time, onboarding new reps, or rep productivity.
Lead left a comment (not just a like) on a sales training post — higher intent.
Company raised a funding round within the last 90 days (Crunchbase / TechCrunch).
Company has active AE, SDR, or BDR job postings on LinkedIn Jobs.
Multiple recent AE job postings, or lead's posts/comments indicate rep churn or team rebuilding.
Lead started current sales leadership role less than 6 months ago.
Company uses a direct competitor's sales training or enablement product.

confidence_levels.high: Signal verified from structured public data (LinkedIn, Crunchbase, company site).
confidence_levels.medium: Signal inferred from post text, job title, or unstructured mentions.
confidence_levels.low: Limited data — signal assumed absent or unknown.

scoring.confidence_cap_rule: If 2 or more fit dimensions are marked low confidence, cap tier at B and flag for review.

A.personalization: required — must reference influencer + matched angle hook

B.description: Good fit, moderate intent. Semi-personalized sequence.
B.personalization: preferred — reference influencer niche at minimum

pain_ramp_time.hook: Saw you're scaling the team — most teams like yours cut AE ramp time by 30–40% with the right onboarding framework.
pain_ramp_time.offer: Free 30-min live training session on exactly that — no pitch, just the framework.

pain_quota.hook: Noticed the conversation about quota attainment — it's the #1 thing we help sales leaders fix.
pain_quota.offer: Free 30-min session with a top B2B sales trainer. No pitch, just a working session.

trigger_funded.hook: Congrats on the raise — the next 90 days of hiring and ramping AEs are the ones that make or break the growth plan.
trigger_funded.offer: Free 30-min session on building a repeatable ramp process before the new hires start.

trigger_new_leader.hook: New role, new targets — the first 90 days set the tone for everything that follows.
trigger_new_leader.offer: Free 30-min session on standing up a repeatable sales process fast.

trigger_hiring.hook: Looks like you're building out the team — the biggest ROI lever at this stage is how fast new reps ramp.
trigger_hiring.offer: Free 30-min training session on cutting ramp time in half.

generic_credibility.hook: We help B2B sales teams at companies like yours improve quota attainment and cut rep ramp time.
generic_credibility.offer: Free 30-min training session — no pitch, just practical tactics your team can use immediately.
